page.layout: One page of text, single column, running text from top to bottom. The page number is at the head. No marginal notes on this page. The fragments at the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.p: cludunt[?], ita tres personae Essentiam divinam perficiunt.

c. Ut angulus, A, respicit angulum, B, & uterque angulus A & B respiciunt simul angulum C, nec ullus praeterea respectus & re-latio requiritur; ita Deus Pater refertur ad Fi-lium, & uterque simul ad Spiritum Sanctum, sicque relatio divina asoluitur[?].
d. ut tres anguli numerica differentia & re-latione differunt, ita tres illae personae in Deo.

e. Omnes tres anguli sunt aequales, ita etiam tres personae: Quivis angulus constat ex lateribus aequalibus, & aequali basi, ita etiam quaelibet persona ex relati & correlati aequali respectu & eodem fundamento: Et deinde quilibet angulus totam aream Trianguli continet, ita quaelibet persona S. S. Trinitatis integram divinam essentiam habet.
β. Omnes radii a centro ad angulos sunt aequales, utpote radii ejusdem peripheriae, ita & personae sunt aequales.
γ. Iterum ut tres anguli & tres radii unam peripheriam continent, ita personae unicam essentiam[?].

page.notes: Section letter "e." is read with some doubt; the sequence of letters suggests it. The header "afoluitur" is hard to read at the fold, so the reading is uncertain. The first word "cludunt" is cut off at the start of the line, so the initial letter is doubtful. The last line "essentiam" may end with a comma or full stop. The catchword "4. De-" is printed at the foot right; the number 4 may belong to the following paragraph. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
